Container.Name: Jobify
Container.Overview: Jobify is a self-hosted job application tracker. Track postings, statuses, interviews and follow-ups, import jobs from LinkedIn, Workday, Greenhouse, Lever and other sites, and optionally use an AI provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama) to summarize postings and draft cover letters.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port for the Jobify web interface.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Where the Jobify database is stored.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID that owns the data directory.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID that owns the data directory.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: How much to write to logs/jobify.log in the data folder: error, warn, log, or debug to record every request.

Config.Name: AI provider
Config.Description: Optional default AI provider: anthropic, openai, gemini, ollama or openai_compatible. Can also be set in the app's Settings page.

Config.Name: AI API key
Config.Description: Optional API key for the default AI provider.

Config.Name: AI model
Config.Description: Optional model for the default AI provider.

Config.Name: AI base URL
Config.Description: Optional base URL, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:11434 for Ollama.
